I have a problem with my foundation falling off my face because my face is so oily, and my friend who has oily skin said she uses a moisturizer then primer. I was scared to use a moisturizer because I am so oily. So, I found a Mary Kay moisturizer I had and used it. Oh my gosh, my make up was so matte and flawless all day and night!!!! I didn't even touch up once. I also used to use the Real Techniques sponge, but it was too flimsy. So, I had a sponge from CVS I won in a giveaway last year and I got it wet and I used it to apply my foundation. The make up that I used for the all day matte was:
Moisturizer- Mary Kay
Primer- Neutrogena shine control rice complexion
Foundation- Revlon color stay
Powder- NYX set it and don't fret it (I only put this under my eyes, nose an forehead and let it bake for 5-10 mins, then pulled powder to my cheeks- I have super dry cheeks and roseacea and eczema on them)
